title: Update and upgrade system with nala
summary: Refresh the list of available packages and upgrade all installed packages to their latest versions using nala.

steps.explain: Update the package list and upgrade all installed packages.

rollback.explain: Downgrading packages is complex and not directly supported by a single nala command. Ensure you have backups before upgrading.

warnings: Upgrading all packages can sometimes cause issues. It is recommended to have a backup.
